```{r Path Dates Patches to ROIs}
patches <- read.csv("/Users/amandadenning/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Collaborations/JeffPhillips_TauPET_Histo/PathData/all_wildcat_cluster_activation.csv") %>% as.data.frame() # id = box ID, we aggregate across boxes so don't care 
patches <- patches[, c("case", "slide", "label", "patch", "contrast", "value")]

# Aggregate
path_data <- aggregate(patches$value, by = list(patches$case, patches$slide, patches$label, patches$contrast), FUN = quantile, probs = 0.99)
colnames(path_data) <- c("AutopsyID", "Slide_ID", "Label_Num", "Contrast", "Value")

# Map labels - changed code from antemortem paper so body/head all goes to same label, since we ended up ignoring that. Though confirm this later ####
path_data$Label_Name <- path_data$Label_Num %>% mapvalues(c("163"), c("CA1")) %>% mapvalues(c("165"), c("CA1-SUB")) %>% mapvalues(c("166"), c("CA2"))  %>% mapvalues(c("167"), c("DG-GCL"))  %>% mapvalues(c("168"), c("DG-H"))  %>% mapvalues(c("169"), c("Sub-PrS"))  %>% mapvalues(c("171"), c("EC-med"))  %>% mapvalues(c("172"), c("EC-ctr"))  %>% mapvalues(c("173"), c("EC-lat"))  %>% mapvalues(c("174"), c("BA35"))  %>% mapvalues(c("175"), c("BA36"))  %>% mapvalues(c("176"), c("Amy"))  %>% mapvalues(c("177"), c("aERC"))  %>% mapvalues(c("180"), c("CA3")) %>% mapvalues(c("181"), c("Ba35"))  %>% mapvalues(c("182"), c("Ba36"))  %>% mapvalues(c("183"), c("EC-med"))  %>% mapvalues(c("184"), c("EC-ctr"))  %>% mapvalues(c("185"), c("EC-lat"))  %>% mapvalues(c("209"), c("DG_MolecularCellLayer"))  %>% mapvalues(c("211"), c("h-uncus-DG-GCL"))  %>% mapvalues(c("212"), c("h-uncus-DG-MolecularCellLayer")) %>% mapvalues(c("213"), c("h-uncus-Ca3")) %>% mapvalues(c("214"), c("h-uncus-DG-H")) %>% mapvalues(c("215"), c("Artifact")) 
# Pivot
path_data <- pivot_wider(path_data, id_cols = c("AutopsyID"), names_from = c("Contrast", "Label_Name"), values_from = "Value")

# Generate summary hippocampus measurement
hipp_combined_tangles <- c("tangles_CA1", "tangles_CA1-SUB", "tangles_CA2", "tangles_CA3", "tangles_DG-GCL", "tangles_DG-H", "tangles_Sub-PrS")
hipp_combined_threads <- c("threads_CA1", "threads_CA1-SUB", "threads_CA2", "threads_CA3", "threads_DG-GCL", "threads_Sub-PrS")

# Check cases with enough ROIs for hipp
path_data$Has_Tau_Quant_3HippRegions <- 0
for (row in 1:nrow(path_data)){
  hippregions <- path_data[row, hipp_combined_tangles]
  ##Identify cases with at least one DG region
  has_DG <- 0
  if(!is.na(hippregions$`tangles_DG-GCL`) | !is.na(hippregions$`tangles_DG-H`)){has_DG <- 1}
  ##Remove DG regions so not double counted
  hippregions <- hippregions[!(colnames(hippregions) %in% c("tangles_DG-H_combined", "tangles_DG-GCL_combined"))]
  ##Check cases with at least 3 regions 
  if(sum(!is.na(hippregions)) + has_DG >= 3){path_data[row, "Has_Tau_Quant_3HippRegions"] <- 1}
}

## For threads, DG-H will be removed. Check if after removing DG-GCL, any cases now have less than 3 regions
DGmismatch <- matrix(NA, ncol = 1) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(DGmismatch) <- "AutopsyID"
for(row in 1:nrow(path_data)){
  hippregions <- path_data[row, hipp_combined_threads]
  if(path_data[row, "Has_Tau_Quant_3HippRegions"] == 1){
    if(sum(!is.na(hippregions)) < 3){DGmismatch <- rbind(DGmismatch, path_data[row, "AutopsyID"])}
  }
}
## DGmismatch is no rows, this indicates there aren't any cases where removing the DG-H layer for threads would make the case now have less than 3 hipp regions. Can just use the Has_Tau_Quant_3HippRegions column name to identify cases where there are at least 3 regions sampled for both tangles and threads. 

# Generate summary scores
path_data$tangles_hippocampus <- NA
path_data[path_data$Has_Tau_Quant_3HippRegions %in% 1, "tangles_hippocampus"] <- rowMeans(path_data[path_data$Has_Tau_Quant_3HippRegions == 1, hipp_combined_tangles], na.rm = TRUE)

path_data$threads_hippocampus <- NA
path_data[path_data$Has_Tau_Quant_3HippRegions == 1, "threads_hippocampus"] <- rowMeans(path_data[path_data$Has_Tau_Quant_3HippRegions == 1, hipp_combined_threads], na.rm = TRUE)

# Export path data of interest
write.csv(path_data, "/Users/amandadenning/Box/Collaborations/JeffPhillips_TauPET_Histo/PathData/ROI_level_path_data.csv", na = "", row.names = FALSE)
# Isolate to ERC, Hippocampus, and Amgydala 
mtl_path <- path_data[, c("AutopsyID", "tangles_Amy", "tangles_aERC", "tangles_hippocampus", "threads_Amy", "threads_aERC", "threads_hippocampus")]
write.csv(mtl_path, "/Users/amandadenning/Box/Collaborations/JeffPhillips_TauPET_Histo/PathData/MTL_path_data.csv", na = "", row.names = FALSE)

rm(patches)
```

```{r Set up old PET}
old_pet <- read.csv("/Users/amandadenning/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Collaborations/JeffPhillips_TauPET_Histo/PET/pet_old_both_hemi.csv")
old_pet$INDDID <- as.character(old_pet$INDDID)

# Define a function to process the PET data for each person and return their PET data in wide format
process_pet_old <- function(INDDID, pet_df, diagnostic_hemi){
  pt_df <- pet_df[pet_df$INDDID == INDDID, ]
  # Get scan date
  date_list <- unique(pt_df$PET)
  processed_dates <- as.Date(character(0))
  for (date in date_list){
    #print(date)
    raw_date <- date
    if(grepl(INDDID, date)){
      date <- gsub(paste0(INDDID, "x"), "", date)
      date <- gsub("xAV1451PETxABC", "", date)
    } else {
      date <- str_split(date, "x")[[1]][1]
    }
    date <- as.Date(date, format = "%Y%m%d")
    processed_dates <- c(processed_dates, date)
    pt_df[pt_df$PET == raw_date, "PET_Scan_Date"] <- date
  }
  # Get last scan date and correct hemisphere that matches path
  pt_df <- pt_df[pt_df$PET_Scan_Date == max(processed_dates) & pt_df$Hemisphere == diagnostic_hemi, ]
  pt_df_wide <- pivot_wider(pt_df, names_from = "Name", values_from = "SUVR", id_cols = c("INDDID", "PET", "Hemisphere", "PET_Scan_Date"))
  pt_df_wide$HippocampusAvg <- rowMeans(pt_df_wide[, c("Anterior_hippocampus", "Posterior_hippocampus")])
  # Return
  return(pt_df_wide)
}

old_pet_processed <- data.frame()
old_pet_processed_contralateral <- data.frame()
autopsy_data$INDDID <- as.character(autopsy_data$INDDID)
for (INDDID in autopsy_data$INDDID){
  if (INDDID %in% old_pet$INDDID){
    # Ipsilateral
    hemi <- autopsy_data[autopsy_data$INDDID == INDDID, "DiagnosticHemisphere"] %>% as.character()
    pt_pet <- process_pet_old(INDDID = INDDID, pet_df = old_pet, diagnostic_hemi = hemi)
    old_pet_processed <- rbind(old_pet_processed, pt_pet)
    
    # Contralateral
    if (hemi == "Right"){contralateral <- "Left"}
    else {contralateral <- "Right"}
    old_pet_processed_contralateral <- rbind(old_pet_processed_contralateral, process_pet_old(INDDID = INDDID, pet_df = old_pet, diagnostic_hemi = contralateral))
  }
}
```

```{r Partial Correlations Ipsilateral}
library(ppcor)
region_matrix <- matrix(c("Hipp", "Amyg", "ERC", "HippocampusAvg_SUVR", "Amygdala_SUVR", "ERCBA35_SUVR", "tangles_hippocampus", "tangles_Amy", "tangles_aERC", "threads_hippocampus", "threads_Amy", "threads_aERC", "Hipp_SQ_Avg", "AmygTau", "ECTau"), nrow = 3) %>% as.data.frame()
colnames(region_matrix) <- c("Region", "PET", "Tangles", "Threads", "SQ")
rownames(region_matrix) <- region_matrix$Region

# Write a function that will run the correlation for one pair of path and regions
run_pcor_single <- function(df, region, path, covary=FALSE){
  # Filter out data that is not eligible
  if (path == "SQ"){
    df <- df[df[[paste0(region, "_Eligible_SQ")]] %in% TRUE, ]
  } else if (path %in% c("Tangles", "Threads")){
    df <- df[df[[paste0(region, "_Eligible_Q")]] %in% TRUE, ]
  }
  # Get variables
  pet_variable <- region_matrix[region, "PET"]
  path_variable <- region_matrix[region, path]
  
  # Run correlation
  if (covary == TRUE){
    # Partial correlation
    my_cor <- pcor(df[, c(pet_variable, path_variable, "Antemortem_Interval_y")], method = "spearman")
    rho <- my_cor$estimate[pet_variable, path_variable]
    p_value <- my_cor$p.value[pet_variable, path_variable]
  } else {
    my_cor <- pcor(df[, c(pet_variable, path_variable)], method = "spearman")
    rho <- my_cor$estimate[pet_variable, path_variable]
    p_value <- my_cor$p.value[pet_variable, path_variable]
  }
  
  # Output
  return(list("rho" = rho, "p_value" = p_value, "N" = nrow(df)))
}

# Write a function to run this for each correlation
run_all_cors <- function(df, covary = FALSE){
  rho_df <- matrix(NA, nrow = 3, ncol = 3) %>% as.data.frame()
  colnames(rho_df) <- c("Tangles", "Threads", "SQ")
  rownames(rho_df) <- c("Hipp", "Amyg", "ERC")
  pval_df <- rho_df
  n_df <- rho_df
  
  cor_df_vis <- rho_df
  
  for(region in rownames(rho_df)){
    for (path in colnames(rho_df)){
      my_cor <- run_pcor_single(df = df, region = region, path = path, covary = covary)
      rho_df[region, path] <- my_cor$rho  
      pval_df[region, path] <- my_cor$p_value
      n_df <- my_cor$N
      if(my_cor$p_value < 0.001){p_star <- sprintf("p < 0.001")} else {p_star <- sprintf("p = %0.3f", my_cor$p_value)}
      
      cor_df_vis[region, path] <- sprintf("ρ = %0.2f, %s, N = %d", my_cor$rho, p_star, my_cor$N)
    }
  }
  
  return(list("rho" = rho_df, "p_val" = pval_df, "cor_vis" = cor_df_vis))
}
```

```{r Demographics}
library(gt)
# ---- Helper Functions ----
mean_sd_range_age <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  
  sprintf(
    "%.1f ± %.1f (%d–%d)",
    mean(x),
    sd(x),
    floor(min(x)),
    floor(max(x))
  )
}

mean_sd_range_num <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  sprintf(
    "%.1f ± %.1f (%0.1f–%0.1f)",
    mean(x),
    sd(x),
    min(x),
    max(x)
  )
}


mean_sd_range_integer <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  sprintf(
    "%.1f ± %.1f (%d–%d)",
    mean(x),
    sd(x),
    min(x),
    max(x)
  )
}

n_pct <- function(x, level) {
  total = length(x)
  if (is.na(level)) {
    n <- sum(is.na(x))
  } else {
    n <- sum(x == level, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, 100 * n / total)
}

format_table <- function(table, N, header_rows){
  table <- table %>% gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Participant Demographics"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Characteristic = "",
    Value = sprintf("Total (N = %d)", N)
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Characteristic) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = Value) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(rows = header_rows)
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps(FALSE) %>%
  opt_vertical_padding(scale = 0.8) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Values are mean ± SD (range) or n (%)."
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.border.top.style = "solid",
    table.border.top.width = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    column_labels.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    column_labels.border.bottom.width = px(1),
    table_body.border.bottom.style = "none",
    table_body.hlines.style = "none",
    table_body.vlines.style = "none", 
    table.width = pct(50),
  )
  return(table)
}

make_demographics_table_INDD <- function(my_df){
  N <- nrow(my_df) 
  age_row <- tibble(Characteristic = "Age at Death", 
                    Value = mean_sd_range_age(my_df$AgeatDeath))
  gender_row <- tibble(Characteristic = "Sex", 
                       Value = sprintf(
                         "%s F / %s M", 
                         n_pct(my_df$Sex, "Female"), 
                         n_pct(my_df$Sex, "Male")
                       ))
  edu_row <- tibble(Characteristic = "Education (years)", 
                    Value = mean_sd_range_integer(my_df$Education))
  # race_levels <- c("White", "Black or African American", "Asian", "More than One Race", NA)
  # race_labels <- c("White", "Black or African American", "Asian", "More than One Race", "Missing")
  # race_rows <- map2_dfr(
  #   race_levels, 
  #   race_labels, 
  #   ~ tibble(
  #     Characteristic = paste0(" ", .y), 
  #     Value = n_pct(my_df$Race, .x)
  #   )
  # )
  # race_header <- tibble(
  #   Characteristic = "Race",
  #   Value = ""
  # )
  # race_block <- bind_rows(race_header, race_rows)
  
  # Clinical diagnosis blocks
  clinical_dx_header <- tibble(
    Characteristic = "Clinical Diagnosis",
    Value = ""
  )
  cdx_values <- sort(unique(as.character(my_df$Diagnosis)))
  cdx_values <- cdx_values[!is.na(cdx_values)]
  
  cdx_rows <- tibble(
    Characteristic = paste0(" ", cdx_values),
    Value = vapply(cdx_values, function(v) n_pct(as.character(my_df$Diagnosis), v),
                   character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  )
  cdx_block <- rbind(clinical_dx_header, cdx_rows)
  
  # ADNC block
  adnc_header <- tibble(
    Characteristic = "ADNC", 
    Value = "")
  adnc_levels <- c("Not", "Low", "Intermediate", "High")
  adnc_rows <- map2_dfr(
    adnc_levels,
    adnc_levels,
    ~ tibble(
      Characteristic = paste0(" ", .y), 
      Value = n_pct(my_df$ADNC, .x)
    )
  )
  
  adnc_block <- rbind(adnc_header, adnc_rows)
  
  # Imaging blocks
  imaging_header <- tibble(
    Characteristic = "[18]*F-Flortaucipir  Imaging",
    Value = ""
  )
  age_at_scan_row <- tibble(Characteristic = "Age at Tau PET Scan",
                  Value = mean_sd_range_age(my_df$AgeAtScan))
  ami_row <- tibble(
    Characteristic = "Antemortem Interval (years)",
    Value = mean_sd_range_num(my_df$Antemortem_Interval_y)
  )
  # pmi_row <- tibble(
  #   Characteristic = "Postmortem Interval (hours)",
  #   Value = mean_sd_range_num(my_df$PMI)
  # )
  imaging_block <- bind_rows(imaging_header, age_at_scan_row, ami_row)

  
  table1 <- bind_rows(
  age_row,
  gender_row,
  edu_row,
  # race_block,
  adnc_block,
  cdx_block,
  imaging_block
  )
  header_rows <- table1$Characteristic %in% c("Race", "18F-Flortaucipir  Imaging", "Clinical Diagnosis", "ADNC")

  
  gt_table <- format_table(table = table1, N = N, header_rows = header_rows)
  return(gt_table)
}

make_demographics_table_INDD(ad_path_oldpet[ad_path_oldpet$ERC_Eligible_Q | ad_path_oldpet$Amyg_Eligible_Q | ad_path_oldpet$Hipp_Eligible_Q, ])

# Make diagnostics tab
make_dx_crosstab_INDD <- function(my_df) {
  npdx1 <- my_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(NPDx1)) %>%
    dplyr::count(Diagnosis = NPDx1, name = "Primary_N")

  npdx2 <- my_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(NPDx2)) %>%
    dplyr::count(Diagnosis = NPDx2, name = "Secondary_N")

  npdx_table <- full_join(npdx1, npdx2, by = "Diagnosis") %>%
    mutate(across(c(Primary_N, Secondary_N), ~replace_na(., 0L))) %>%
    mutate(
      Primary_Pct   = Primary_N   / sum(Primary_N)   * 100,
      Secondary_Pct = Secondary_N / sum(Secondary_N) * 100
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Primary_N))

  gt_table <- npdx_table %>%
    gt() %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(Primary_Pct, Secondary_Pct), decimals = 1) %>%
    cols_merge_n_pct(col_n = Primary_N,   col_pct = Primary_Pct) %>%
    cols_merge_n_pct(col_n = Secondary_N, col_pct = Secondary_Pct) %>%
    cols_label(
      Primary_N   = "Primary",
      Secondary_N = "Secondary"
    ) %>%
    cols_align(align = "left", columns = Diagnosis) %>%
    cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(Primary_N, Secondary_N)) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.border.top.style = "solid",
      table.border.top.width = px(2),
      table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
      table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
      column_labels.border.bottom.style = "solid",
      table_body.hlines.style = "none"
    )

  return(gt_table)
}

make_dx_crosstab_INDD(ad_path_oldpet[ad_path_oldpet$ERC_Eligible_Q | ad_path_oldpet$Amyg_Eligible_Q | ad_path_oldpet$Hipp_Eligible_Q, ])

#ABC Tables
make_staging_table_INDD <- function(my_df) {
  vars <- list(
    "A"          = my_df$ABeta,
    "B"          = my_df$B_Score,
    "C"          = my_df$CERAD,
    "LATE Stage" = my_df$LATE_Stage
  )

  rows <- map2_dfr(vars, names(vars), function(vec, label) {
    tibble(
      Characteristic = label,
      `0` = sum(vec == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      `1` = sum(vec == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      `2` = sum(vec == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
      `3` = sum(vec == 3, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })

  gt_table <- rows %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_spanner(label = "Staging", columns = c(`0`, `1`, `2`, `3`)) %>%
    cols_align(align = "left", columns = Characteristic) %>%
    cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(`0`, `1`, `2`, `3`)) %>%
    tab_options(
      table.border.top.style = "solid",
      table.border.top.width = px(2),
      table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
      table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
      column_labels.border.bottom.style = "solid",
      table_body.hlines.style = "none"
    )

  return(gt_table)
}
make_staging_table_INDD(ad_path_oldpet[ad_path_oldpet$ERC_Eligible_Q | ad_path_oldpet$Amyg_Eligible_Q | ad_path_oldpet$Hipp_Eligible_Q, ])
```
